concept: Hosting, domains and email as label tape, rendered in 3D (Blender). One roll of gloss black embossing tape on a sky-blue table, the letters really pressed up out of it, shot from the front left three ways. The tape off its roll, pressed YOURNAME.CO.UK: put your name on it. From higher, a second label going down under the first, HELLO@YOURNAME.CO.UK, the two lined up on the name, one end still lifted and its backing paper beside it: then on your email. Then a wider white tape printed with the Nexulabs wordmark laid in front, its roll beside the black one: we'll host it too. Sky blue, gloss black, pressed white and one white tape; Bricolage Grotesque.
